title: Caddy
subtitle: Designing the shopping experience around an AI recommendation assistant.

evidence.statement: 2.22% baseline conversion rate compared with 1.86% for selector tools
19.4% higher baseline conversion than selector tools
19.04% add-to-cart rate, up 25.1% period over period

quickView.problem: The AI could recommend products, but the presentation made them hard to evaluate and act on.
quickView.evolution: Fixed selector → conversation → refined recommendations presented through familiar ecommerce patterns
quickView.product: A conversational discovery experience with ecommerce product cards.
quickView.impact: Caddy users had a 2.22% baseline conversion rate, 19.4% higher than selector tools at 1.86%, plus a 19.04% add-to-cart rate.
quickView.learning: The model was not the product. The experience around its answer was.
